newsitem.title: USA: Harris Corp gets additional contract work.
newsitem.headline: Harris Corp gets additional contract work.

text.p: Harris Corp said Thursday it has been awarded a $72 million contract to provide advanced avionics for the U.S. Army's RAH-66 Comanche helicopter.
The company said it was an extension of another contract that it began working on in 1991, bringing the total overall value of the program to $170 million.
Under the new contract, Harris will integrate the latest technology on the fiber-optic networks and computer processing for the performance of the reconnaissance and attack helicopter.
Boeing Co and Sikorsky Aircraft Corp, a unit of United Technologies Corp are the prime contractors for the RAH-66, with Harris providing avionics support work.
